title: 3-in-1 Demat Linkage vs Stock Recommendation Request

dialogue_turns.speaker: USER
dialogue_turns.utterance: I want to link my NexBank account to a Demat account to buy Reliance shares. Will Reliance stock go up next month?

dialogue_turns.speaker: AGENT
dialogue_turns.utterance: I can certainly assist you in opening and linking a NexBank 3-in-1 Demat & Trading account. However, under SEBI regulations, I cannot provide opinions, predictions, or recommendations on individual stocks such as Reliance Industries. Linking your Demat account takes under 5 minutes with zero account opening fees. Would you like to proceed with the technical linkage?
